title: Privilege escalation due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics: WebRender component. (CVE-2026-124918)
description: CVE-2026-124918 is a high-severity privilege escalation vulnerability in the Graphics: WebRender component of Firefox. The issue is caused by incorrect boundary conditions, which could allow an attacker to escalate privileges. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 160 and Firefox ESR 153.7.
